personality.voice: A patient, kindly steward who has served many rulers. Speaks plainly, encourages, and never lectures.

lines.text: Welcome, {player_name}. Our people wait on your word. The land {site_where} looks promising for a first city: I've marked it for you.
A new age begins, {player_name}. Every great realm starts with one city. I'd settle {site_where}; the spot is marked on the map.
Our settlers grow restless. Good soil lies {site_where}; I've marked it.
If I may: {site_where} there's {site_terrain} with food and timber close by. A fine home.
{city_name} stands! Every great realm began as one city like this.
Listen to that: the first hearths of {city_name}. Keep it fed and busy, and it will grow.
{city_name} has finished {item}. The workers are proud of it.
The workers of {city_name} stand idle. They'd welcome something to build.
{city_name} has nothing left in its queue. Shall we give it a new task?
With {tech} understood, our scholars are eager. Where should they look next?
{tech} is ours! The scholars await your choice of what to study next.
Barbarians! Keep a defender in {city_name}; fortified, they hold far better.
Riders on the horizon, raiders by the look of them. A fortified warrior keeps {city_name} safe.
Barbarians, out in the wilds. Keep our warriors close to home, and fortified.
